description: Apply lookup, neighbor, mutation, and range operations to a bounded sorted integer set and return a checksum of observations and final keys.

opcodes.6: insert(a, upsert); b=0 or 1, explicitly mapped to false/true

input.checksum: weighted operation observations plus position-weighted final sorted keys; iterator observations use an order-sensitive polynomial hash

output.meaning: weighted checksum of operation results and final sorted keys
